title: Brian Fitzpatrick's cattle mutilation book

tellings.quote: And it's it's an astonishing book. I it's the I think it's the biggest reveal about cattle mutilations out there.

plain: A book called The Operator, by a man named Brian Fitzpatrick, holds what may be the biggest revelation yet about cattle mutilations, the cases of cattle found dead and strangely cut. That is the view of Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, who tells Michels it is "an astonishing book" and "the biggest reveal about cattle mutilations out there", though he does not say here what it reveals.
